label: Stage A Frozen
description: Document-derived baseline built from source tiers 1-4 with no network access. Deterministic: identical source documents reproduce this byte-for-byte apart from generatedAt.

bytesNotRetained.reason: These were listed in the original freeze record but their Stage A bytes are not retained separately; the live copies have since changed across later releases. Their Stage-A-era hashes are therefore not asserted rather than reconstructed.

recordProvenance.reason: freeze_stage_a.py was run against the live catalog directory during the multilingual batch loop, overwriting the record with the live 1.31.0-alpha catalog's byteSize and checksums under the 1.0.0-alpha label. Rebuilt from the untouched baseline copy at stage_a_frozen/.
recordProvenance.evidence: stage_a_frozen/scheme_catalog.json is unmodified since 2026-08-04 and carries catalogVersion 1.0.0 in its own metadata; every value above is read from that file.

regenerationRule: Stage A is NOT regenerated except when a source document changes. All subsequent improvement occurs through Stage B passes or a future catalog release. Any regeneration requires a new release identifier and a fresh freeze record.
downstreamRule: Stage B Pass 1 (verification) MUST NOT mutate any Stage A content value. Stage B Pass 2 (enrichment) MAY populate fields that are null in Stage A, and MUST NOT modify fields Stage A populated.
